label: Budgeting a two-level loop
subgoals: Multiply the screened candidates by the fast run time
Multiply verified candidates, corners and accurate run time
Add the two stages and compare their shares

label: Speedup over all-accurate
subgoals: Compute the cost of verifying every candidate at every corner
Divide it by the two-level cost
Check that the fast ranking is validated over the searched region

label: Which candidates must be re-verified
subgoals: Form the band of the specification plus and minus the error bound
Accept values above the band and reject values below it
Count the values inside the band for accurate re-simulation
